repo.description:
### Impact

A stored HTML injection in the Mail app's message list allowed an authenticated user to inject HTML into the email subjects. Javascript was correctly blocked by the content security policy of the Nextcloud Server code.

### Patches

It is recommended that the Mail app is upgraded to 5.5.3.

### Workarounds

* Disable Mail app

### References

* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/3357036)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/mail/pull/11740)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: Mail stored HTML injection in subject text
